lead.note: **15593 Eco Lake Park (IN, new 2026-10-31):** lakefront on a 9-acre county lake, lake-side pads ~15-25 m on open slope; southern pads on undated Google tiles only; Google's summary says 'decent pond', so `pond` is the alternative.
lead.prior_evidence: Jennings County's park map draws the loop's spurs at the north shore of its nine-acre lake. Satellite: Indiana 2025 ortho (north half of the loop) and Google leaf-off imagery at 39.1229,-85.7579 show the west and south lake-side gravel pads ~15-25 m from the waterline, with open ground, scattered trees and a thin brush fringe between (no road, lot or used strip; only the county's footpath loop). County photo images1/ecolake7.jpg shows a trailer on a site above a grass slope running to the water (undated, after the 2023 build). USGS 3DEP: pad 206.7 m vs lake 204.6 m, ~20 m apart, so a walkable slope, not a bluff; pads are above pool, beside the embankment I read as the dam at the lake's north-west end (3DEP 202 m below it).
